OUR STORY

Local knowledge.
Lasting memories.

Pamir Ecotourism is based in the Rushan district of GBAO, Tajikistan. The team creates journeys through the Pamirs and beyond, bringing travelers closer to the landscapes and communities of the region.

Every good trip starts with a conversation. Tell us what excites you, and we will help shape a route that makes sense for your time and travel style.
